units.source_text: 他开始拼命挖起沙子来。

en.t: He began digging the sand desperately.

units.source_text: 沙子是那样地顺从，任务好像能够完成。

en.t: The sand yielded so obediently that the task seemed possible to complete.

units.source_text: 只听见铁锹插进沙子的声音和自己的喘息声，时间一分一分地逝去。

en.t: With only the sound of the shovel biting into the sand and his own panting to hear, time slipped away minute by minute.

units.source_text: 谁知没过多久，手腕的疲劳便开始低低地发出警告。

en.t: Before long, however, the fatigue in his wrists began to send out a low warning.

units.source_text: 他觉得已经挖了够多了，然而，却没有任何效果。

en.t: He felt he had already dug enough, yet it had no effect at all.

units.source_text: 滑落的沙子，老在眼鼻子底下打转，只有一小部分。

en.t: Only a small portion of the sliding sand kept circling right under his nose.

units.source_text: 头脑里所描绘的那单纯的几何学流程，怕是什么地方完全搞错了吧。

en.t: The simple geometric process he had pictured in his mind must have been completely wrong somewhere.
